messages:
Aisha: Heads-up — after the driver rollforward to 535.54 we started seeing a ~4x increase in Xid errors from the eu-west GPU fleet. Noticed more node drains and job preempts than usual. Anyone tracking this?

Luca: saw a few alerts earlier. Mostly A100s in the eu-west-2 pool. Before rollforward we'd seen ~0.2/hr, now ~0.9/hr across the pool.

Priya: Can you paste a short log sample? Also which firmware/kernel combo did the canary use?

Aisha: Canary used kernel 6.1.21 + nv-driver 535.54 + fw 48.2. Logs: ```
[2026-03-17T09:12:03Z] GPU0 Xid=13 Tesla A100-40C ECC uncorrectable error
[2026-03-17T09:12:04Z] GPU0 process pid=7421 (trainer) killed due to Xid
[2026-03-17T09:12:04Z] dmesg: NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus
```

Nate: Interesting — our eu-central canary (same driver but fw 47.x) didn't spike. That points at the firmware delta.

Priya: I ran kernel oops pattern match across drains. Most show the same call path: ```nvrm: rm_init -> nv_kthread -> nvosd_exec -> nvidia_drm_ioctl```. Not definitive but consistent.

Luca: Are affected nodes all on the same hardware revision? Could be a flaky batch.

Aisha: Checked HW batches: mix of rev B and rev C. Rev C seems overrepresented in failures (~75%).

ops-bot: Scheduled: drain start for group eu-west-gpu-pool at 2026-03-17T09:30:00Z (rolling, 5 nodes at a time).

Priya: Quick triage checklist I'm running: 1) confirm reproducibility on isolated canary 2) reimage with previous fw+driver to see regression 3) collect ECC counters before/after 4) kernel oops + NVRM logs 5) collect dmesg + lspci -vvv

Aisha: Repro steps: took a node, applied 535.54 + fw48.2, ran perf workload for 2 hours -> Xid ~2/hr. Rolled back driver to 535.27 + fw47.9 -> Xid ~0.1/hr.

Nate: That's a strong signal for the combo. Can we confirm with single-card test on same board to rule out interconnect?

Luca: I'll spin up single-card test on gpu-eu-single-03 and run the training loop script for 3h. Will post results. :thumbsup:

Priya: Also, please grab `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.mode.current,ecc.errors.uncorrected.volatile --format=csv` before/after run.

Aisha: Filed a ticket with vendor: RID# 2026-03-17-REDWOOD-378. Included logs + hw serials + diff of fw. Waiting on vendor reply.

Nate: Short-term mitigation options: 1) pin eu-west nodes to previous driver/firmware (rollback) 2) adjust autoscaler to reduce packing density on rev C boards 3) add a soft-failure detector to move noisy GPUs to isolated pool

Luca: Rollback would be fastest to reduce customer impact. What's the rollback risk?

Priya: Rollback script exists but needs a canary verification pass. I'll prepare a safe rollback playbook (drain -> rollback -> smoke -> uncordon).

Aisha: OK — action plan: Priya to prepare rollback playbook + smoke tests (ETA 2h). Luca to finish single-card repro (ETA 3h). Nate to coordinate vendor comms and prepare autoscaler tweak PR (ETA EOD). I'll monitor alerts and pause any further driver rollouts.

Nate: Noted. If vendor confirms fw is implicated, we'll schedule a coordinated fw update with extra canaries and hardware gating.

Luca: Update from single-card test: 3h run completed, Xid=0 on rev B board, Xid=3 on rev C board. Uploading raw logs to the incident ticket.

Priya: Thanks. Priya: Draft rollback playbook posted in the ticket. Includes `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` sequence and post-rollback smoke script: ```
python smoke_train.py --steps 50 --batch 8
```

Aisha: OK executing rollback canary now on gpu-eu-standby-01. Will report back with success/failure. :crossed_fingers:

ops-bot: Alert suppressed for group eu-west-gpu-pool during maintenance window 09:30-11:30Z.

Aisha: Rollback canary finished: no Xids in 90m smoke. Rolling out rollback to next 4 nodes.

Priya: Great. Keep an eye on fleet-wide ECC counters. We should add a regression alert for Xid rate increase post-driver/fw change (threshold on delta > 2x baseline).

Nate: I'll open a follow-up RFC to add a hardware gating step to our rollout pipeline: include firmware compatibility matrix per HW rev.

Aisha: Closing loop: vendor responded — acknowledged possible fw regression on rev C boards; preparing patched fw. We'll keep nodes pinned to older fw until validated.

Luca: Thanks everyone. Good catch. :clap:

Aisha: Filing short postmortem and followups in the incident doc. Items: add Xid regression alert, hardware gating in rollout pipeline, update rollback runbook, vendor fw validation plan.
